meta.name: building-threat-hunt-hypothesis-framework
meta.description: Build a systematic threat hunt hypothesis framework that transforms threat intelligence, attack patterns, and environmental data into testable hunting hypotheses.

copy.tagline: 将威胁情报转化为可测试的狩猎假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统化地构建威胁狩猎假设框架
copy.tagline_en: Transform threat intelligence into testable hunting hypotheses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically build a threat hunt hypothesis framework

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会引导你按步骤构建威胁狩猎假设：基于威胁情报或ATT&CK差距分析提出假设，确定数据源，执行查询，分析结果，验证发现，关联活动，并记录报告。
howto.when: 当你想主动搜索环境中的威胁指标、威胁情报显示活跃攻击活动、或进行事件响应、安全评估时触发。

say.text: 帮我基于APT29报告构建一个狩猎假设。
say.note: Claude会引导你完成假设构建流程。

say.text: 分析ATT&CK覆盖差距，生成一个狩猎假设。
say.note: Claude会基于差距分析提出假设。

say.text: 根据UEBA告警异常，帮我制定一个狩猎计划。
say.note: Claude会从异常出发构建假设。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through building a threat hunt hypothesis: formulate hypothesis from threat intel or ATT&CK gap analysis, identify data sources, execute queries, analyze results, validate findings, correlate activity, and document.
howto.when_en: Triggered when proactively hunting for threat indicators, after threat intelligence indicates active campaigns, during incident response, or during security assessments.

say_en.text: Help me build a hunt hypothesis based on APT29 report.
say_en.note: Claude will walk you through the process.

say_en.text: Analyze ATT&CK coverage gaps and generate a hypothesis.
say_en.note: Claude will propose a hypothesis from gap analysis.

say_en.text: Create a hunt plan from a UEBA alert anomaly.
say_en.note: Claude will build a hypothesis from the anomaly.
